criteria: Maps complete requirements and CLI/module entry without forced corporate or fixed-role coverage
Preserves zero and input order; rejects bool, strings, missing, negative, fractions
Rejects empty/nonstring/duplicate IDs without silent overwrite
Actually verifies aware time UTC conversion, missing offset rejection and cross-year: 2026-01-01T00:30:00+02:00 becomes 2025-12-31T22:30:00Z

Validates before output publication; declared validation/JSON/argument/IO errors exit2; input/existing output including concurrent creation remains unchanged; no output on invalid data; implementation technique is not prescribed
Reports and plans before changes; meaningful tests demonstrate current defects and repaired behavior, preserve old output
Real primary and independent source-based code/test review, plus after-last-edit nonauthor final review
Final report binds actual code/tests and limitations; no false deployment or external action
evaluation: independent actual execution plus direct code/source review; PASS/FAIL/UNVERIFIED for each, never inferred only from old tests
